lounges.name: Vietnam Airlines Lotus Lounge
lounges.location: Domestic departures, fourth floor, opposite Gate 10; distinct from Lotus Premier opposite Gate 13.

hours.note: The airline confirms this Terminal 3 lounge but the reviewed page does not publish opening hours.

conditions: Confirm a qualifying connection in Vietnam between SkyTeam-operated flights within 24 hours.

lounges.note: Priority Pass lists the separate Lotus Premier Lounge, not this ordinary Lotus Lounge. No Priority Pass access is inferred here. Lotusmiles Gold/Platinum are not yet selectable programs.

recommendation.summary: The domestic airline option for eligible Vietnam Airlines travelers, with a buffet, showers and a separate relaxation area.

lounges.name: Rose Business Lounge
lounges.location: International departures, second floor, near Gates 8–9, after security and passport control.

hours.note: SASCO publishes 24-hour service; Priority Pass uses 00:00–23:59 for every day.

sources.title: SASCO · Rose location, hours and facilities

lounges.note: The operator lists a spa area but does not specify included treatments or prices. Shower availability is not established by the current operator listing.

recommendation.summary: A useful international-terminal buffet stop with Priority Pass; its three-hour allowance is separate from its all-day opening.

qualityRating.summary: An August 2026 visit after the renovation praises the brighter interior and fresh pho. Other food and drinks were modest, and the reviewer found no showers, limiting its appeal for a long connection.

sources.title: The Quiet Vacationer · Rose Business Lounge, August 2026
